text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Fine Motion's departure for 
home has finally arrived. She puts on a 
cheerful face with her usual smile. Crowds 
of fans flock to the airport to see her 
off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It spoke volumes of the impact Fine Motion 
had left behind and the scale of the 
dreams she showed everyone. With tears in 
her eyes, she returned to her home 
country—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—However! She returned to the Academy as a 
'Goodwill Ambassador of Japan'... They say 
it's thanks to her accomplishments being 
recognized.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a new mission in her heart—to "become 
a bridge between Japan and Ireland"—she 
begins running alongside her Trainer once 
more.
